06380 Pokereth Ts@bayiym {po-keh'-reth tseb-aw-yeem'}

源自與第一個字相同形式的主動分詞
一個不使用的字根之陰性 (意為"設網羅") 06643的複數型; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Pochereth of Zebaim 2; 2

玻黑列  哈斯巴音= "羚羊的陷阱(?)"

1) 所羅門的僕人，與所羅巴伯歸回的人有他的子孫 (#拉 2:57; 尼 7:59|)
record.edic_text:
06380 Pokereth Ts@bayiym {po-keh'-reth tseb-aw-yeem'}

from the act. part. (of the same form as the first word) fem. of an
   unused root (meaning to entrap) and pl. of 06643;; n pr m

AV - Pochereth of Zebaim 2; 2

Pochereth of Zebaim = "here the cutting off"
1) a servant of Solomon whose descendants returned from exile with
   Zerubbabel
